# shop data models

shop keeps accounts, orders and invoices in Postgres, sessions, carts and the product catalogue in Redis, and reviews and clickstream events in MongoDB. Postgres is the system of record; Redis entries can be rebuilt or expire.

**Highlights**

- Orders reference users by foreign key; Redis sessions and Mongo events reference them by id only, unchecked.
- Sessions expire after 30 minutes; carts never expire, so abandoned carts accumulate.
- Product data lives only in Redis hashes, indexed by Redis Search for the catalogue page.

| [**Reviews**](#reviews) | MongoDB 7.0.43 | Product reviews and clickstream events. | Durable | 3 | Sampled, 2026-10-11 |
